summary.text: PvP is live since the Nov 4, 2026 launch (season 1). Progression has two tracks: Honor (currency) and Rank Points (14 ranks, weekly cap). Honor buys a blue set; the epic set = blue piece + rank-gated Emboldened Seal. Four battlegrounds at launch (Warsong Gulch, Arathi Basin, Darkspear Islands, Alterac Valley); no arenas or rated PvP announced. Battlegrounds mix all rulesets except Hardcore, but there is no cross-ruleset or cross-faction grouping. Your rank, Rank Points and buyable rewards are on Character pane (C) > Player vs. Player tab.

rulesets.name: Normal
rulesets.notes: Fight other players at your own discretion. Both factions allowed on the account.

rulesets.name: PvP
rulesets.notes: Almost always at risk of being attacked by the other faction. Only one faction per account on this ruleset; faction-balance systems (Season of Discovery style creation limits).

rulesets.name: Roleplay
rulesets.notes: Strict naming and behaviour rules. Both factions allowed.

rulesets.name: Roleplay PvP
rulesets.notes: Roleplay rules plus open-world PvP (almost always at risk). Blizzard post does not state its faction limit.

rulesets.name: Hardcore
rulesets.notes: After launch; fully separate ecosystem, not in shared battlegrounds; a dead Hardcore character can transfer to another ruleset incl. PvP.

honor.cap_note: Honor cap raised from 15,000 to 25,000 in the Oct 1 beta build (Blizzard dev notes); gear/token Honor costs +~50% in the same build. Live cap not restated since launch.
earn: Extra Honor in the highlighted battleground during its holiday week
Legacy perk 'For Great Honor' increases Honor gains
honor.notes: Honor gains were reviewed so battlegrounds are more even (Alterac Valley not the only efficient choice). Killing a player at Honor cap no longer shows honor gained (dev notes). Per-kill/per-win amounts not published.

rank_points.notes: Rank Points come from battlegrounds and relevant PvP quests (holiday-week battlegrounds give a boost) and advance the 14 original ranks to Grand Marshal (Alliance) / High Warlord (Horde). Weekly cap is official; cap values are not. decay=false is from secondary pages (loreforever citing Icy Veins/Blizzpro, wowforevertierlist) - Blizzard does not mention decay. Beta data (lfcarry, thetirisfalen): Rank 14 = 24,750 Rank Points, earliest in season week 10 - unconfirmed.

gear_path.text: Honor buys two PvP sets: blue (rare) and epic. Epic = matching blue piece + Emboldened Seal; seals have rank requirements. New/reworked sets fill missing specs. Earning a rank does not award the item - buy the blue piece, reach the rank, buy the seal, upgrade.
gear_path.emboldened_seal: Rank-gated upgrade item per slot (R8 bracers/belt, R9 boots, R10 gloves, R12 legs/shoulders, R13 chest/helm); weapons are R14 rewards.

roles.Retribution: Best: attacker and flag hunter (A); carrier B, defender B, healer C. Pursuit of Justice to close, Hammer of Justice > Judgement (Seal of Command) > Holy Strike, instant Hammer of Wrath at 30 yd on a fleeing carrier.
roles.Holy: Best: healer on the carrier/escort (S); defender A, carrier B. Oath of Light + Light's Vigil on the carrier, Holy Shock on the move, Blessing of Freedom for the first slow; defend from the flag-room doorway.
roles.Protection: No per-map Protection rating published; foreverbattlegrounds' Paladin summary calls Protection (Templar's Bulwark, Seal of Fury absorbs) 'the safest flag carrier'.

battlegrounds.name: Darkspear Islands

battlegrounds.alliance_queue: Battlemaster in any major capital city, or the Theramore Expeditionary Force base at Northwatch (The Barrens), whose portal takes you into the battle.

roles.Retribution: Attacker (A) / roamer (A); carrier B. queue.text: Queue at a battlemaster: Blizzard says every major capital city has one (Darkspear post); secondary pages name Stormwind Keep (and Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar, Horde). Darkspear Islands also via the Northwatch portal. No remote queue button (players asked Oct 7, no reply); players report being returned to where they accepted the queue. Battlegrounds mix rulesets (not Hardcore) but you cannot queue as a group with a friend on another ruleset.

call_to_arms.text: Each battleground has holiday weeks: the highlighted battleground gives increased Honor and an additional Rank Point boost. foreverdb (client) calls them Call to Arms weeks for Warsong Gulch, Arathi Basin, Darkspear Islands and Alterac Valley; schedule not published.

seasonal.text: PvP runs in seasons. Each season has a journey of weekly tasks granting Honor and Rank Points; three tasks per season also grant a Legacy Point and stay completable in later seasons. Legacy PvP challenges (12 points): reach ranks 3, 7, 10, 13 and 14 (5), Exalted with each battleground reputation (4), and the week 4, 7 and 10 quests of the 'Field of Honor' season journey (3). Legacy perk 'For Great Honor' (Resourcefulness tree) increases Honor gains. First PvP season refresh: spring 2027 (roadmap), second: summer 2027 (lfcarry).

cooldowns.notes: 6 s stun at level 54 (rank 4), 10 yd range. Improved Hammer of Justice (Protection, 3 pts) -15 s -> 45 s. PvP set: -10 s (foreverbattlegrounds Holy page). Only way for Paladins to stop a cast (no interrupt).
cooldowns.flag: Cooldown/duration only on secondary fansites (foreverbattlegrounds, thetirisfalen); no Blizzard or Icy Veins number

cooldowns.notes: Retribution 21-point talent (Blizzard deep dive). Incapacitates a Humanoid for 6 s, any damage breaks it, stops your swing timer vs them (Icy Veins). 20 yd, 1 min cooldown (foreverbattlegrounds). Chevalier PvP gloves: 7 s. /cast Repentance + /cast Judgement in one macro gives the Seal of Command bonus without breaking it (Icy Veins).
cooldowns.flag: Duration from Icy Veins; cooldown and range from foreverbattlegrounds only

cooldowns.notes: Learned at 34. Immune to damage; you keep attacking at -50% damage dealt (Icy Veins). Sacred Duty (Protection) -60 s cooldown and -10 s Forbearance. Base cooldown not on any archived page.
cooldowns.flag: 12 s and Forbearance from foreverbattlegrounds/thetirisfalen; damage penalty disputed (see conflicts)

cooldowns.notes: Immune to physical attacks and spells but you cannot attack (Icy Veins: stops your attacks; usable vs fall damage). Sacred Duty -60 s. Base cooldown not on any archived page.

Physical immunity on you or a party/raid member; target loses aggro; prevents your attacks (Icy Veins/thetirisfalen). Guardian's Favor (Protection) -2 min cooldown. Replaces your other Blessing on that target - recast it afterwards (Icy Veins). Base cooldown not on any archived page.

Immunity to movement-impairing effects, removes active roots/slows, castable on party/raid (Icy Veins). Learned at 18, 10 s, 20 s cooldown (foreverbattlegrounds). Guardian's Favor +6 s -> 16 s. Replaces your other Blessing on the target - re-apply Blessing of Might/Kings afterwards (Icy Veins + foreverbattlegrounds).

Cooldown reduced to 20 min from 1 hour (Blizzard deep dive; Improved Lay on Hands made baseline). Heals for your maximum health, drains your remaining mana (Icy Veins). Forbearance: not stated by any source.

Protection 21-point talent (row 3 since Nov 2): absorb shield = 100% of max health for 8 s; applies Forbearance and cannot be used under Forbearance. Since Nov 2 it is a Magic effect and dispellable. Sacred Duty -60 s.
Holy 21-point talent; cooldown 10 s (was 30 s). Light's Vigil makes the next Holy Shock on that ally skip its cooldown. Range 20 yd per foreverbattlegrounds (unconfirmed).

Rank 2 reward (Blizzard). foreverdb names Insignia of the Alliance (18854) / Insignia of the Horde (18834), one per class (unconfirmed). Effect and cooldown not on any archived page. Cooldown Manager supports trinkets (Blizzard dev notes).
Human racial (Tristan is Human): removes all Stuns. Only foreverbattlegrounds gives the effect/cooldown.

forbearance.text: Divine Shield, Divine Protection, Blessing of Protection and Templar's Bulwark share Forbearance: normally one bubble per minute. Templar's Bulwark applies Forbearance and cannot be cast while it is active (Blizzard). Sacred Duty reduces Forbearance by 5/10 s (Blizzard Nov 2 notes).
forbearance.flag: 1 min duration only from the talent tooltip text quoted by foreverbattlegrounds/thetirisfalen; Blizzard gives no base duration

Retribution.note: Optional prep vs Hunters/Mages: on yourself before closing in, then re-apply Blessing of Might (Freedom replaces it).
6 s stun, 10 yd - opens the window. Seal of Command must be active.
With Seal of Command: roughly double damage on a stunned/incapacitated target. Off the GCD (Icy Veins).
While the stun lasts (Sacred Arbiter refreshes all Judgements on the target).
Second window (20 yd, 6 s) on another target or after the stun. Damage breaks it; /cast Repentance + /cast Judgement in one macro keeps the bonus without breaking it (Icy Veins).
Finisher at 20% health or lower, 30 yd; instant with Champion of the Light 5/5. Keep mana for it.

burst.Retribution_unsealed_wrath: With Unsealed Wrath: swing with Seal of Command to store up to 3 echoes (15 s), then swap Seal just before the stun lands so the stored copies proc together.

Holy.note: On the flag carrier the moment the flag is picked up (5 min, one Oath at a time; boosts Holy Light/Flash of Light/Holy Shock on them).
On the carrier/focused ally before the chase: next Holy Shock on them has no cooldown and heals their party (friendly targets only since Nov 2; one per party).
Instant heal on the move; fire twice in a row with Light's Vigil.
Removes a poison, a disease and a magic effect (incl. magical crowd control) - Cleanse a capper before healing.
First Hunter/Mage slow or root on the carrier.
Save for the enemy's first burst on you (8 s, Forbearance).

world_pvp_tips.title: PvP ruleset = always at risk
world_pvp_tips.body: On PvP and Roleplay PvP rulesets you are almost always at risk of attack by the other faction; on Normal you fight only by choice. You cannot move a character between rulesets.

world_pvp_tips.title: Crowded zones thinned (Nov 6)
world_pvp_tips.body: Blizzard lowered player population in congested zones, with a bigger change on the PvP ruleset after overcrowding feedback.

world_pvp_tips.title: Leveling in contested zones
world_pvp_tips.body: On the PvP ruleset every trip into contested territory is dangerous while you level.

world_pvp_tips.title: Escape kit
world_pvp_tips.body: Blessing of Freedom (immune to roots/slows, removes them) plus Pursuit of Justice lets you run away; Hammer of Justice buys distance or time to cast Holy Light; Repentance (Humanoids) also gives you distance.

world_pvp_tips.title: Bubbles
world_pvp_tips.body: Divine Protection gives a breather but stops your attacks; Divine Shield (34) lets you keep attacking at -50% damage. They share Forbearance with Blessing of Protection (see forbearance).

world_pvp_tips.title: No slows or gap closers
world_pvp_tips.body: Retribution's biggest PvP issue is no slows/gap closers vs ranged players; Engineering grenades are incredibly potent PvP tools for Paladins.

world_pvp_tips.title: Recast your Blessing
world_pvp_tips.body: Blessing of Freedom or Blessing of Protection replaces your other Blessing on the target - recast Blessing of Might/Kings afterwards (one Blessing per Paladin per player).

world_pvp_tips.title: Freedom before you close
world_pvp_tips.body: Against Hunters and Mages put Blessing of Freedom on yourself before closing in, then re-apply Blessing of Might.
world_pvp_tips.flag: foreverbattlegrounds only (secondary fansite; verify in game)

world_pvp_tips.title: Human Will to Survive
world_pvp_tips.body: Human racial removes all Stuns (3 min) - your answer to a stun-lock gank.
world_pvp_tips.flag: foreverbattlegrounds only (secondary fansite; verify in game)

world_pvp_tips.title: Legacy perk High Alert
world_pvp_tips.body: Adventure perk 'High Alert' increases stealth detection outside battlegrounds - useful vs Rogue/Druid ganks on the PvP ruleset.

world_pvp_tips.title: No Spy
world_pvp_tips.body: Spy (enemy player detector for world PvP) has no Forever version; enemy cooldown trackers depend on the restricted combat log. Watch nameplates instead (BetterBlizzPlates or Plater).

limits.why: COMBAT_LOG_EVENT is removed and Combat Log chat-tab text is a string type addons cannot parse - no kill-blow credit, enemy cooldown/trinket tracking, DR tracking or log-based enemy detection.

Other units' health %/missing (UnitHealthPercent/UnitHealthMissing), power %/missing, primary resources and casts are Secret: addon code can pass them to bars/cooldown widgets but not compare them - e.g. 'target under 20% for Hammer of Wrath' cannot be computed.
Aura lists and UNIT_AURA still fire, but aura contents are Secret; helper functions (instance IDs, has-expiration, counts, dispel colours) remain.

In instances chat reaches addons as Secrets and addons may not send any chat or addon messages; creature names/GUIDs/IDs are Secret. Blizzard does not say whether battlegrounds count - assume yes: no BG callouts or addon sync.
limits.flag: Midnight documentation Forever inherits; not Forever-tested; BG applicability unknown

limits.what: Secure code out of combat only
limits.why: Secure snippets (bar paging, click-casting) run out of combat; one press = one action.
Blizzard's stated aim: addons should not automate combat decisions; named targets include relabelling enemies by role ('Healer'), renaming casts, and colouring nameplates by priority.
The only Forever statement is a Blizzard rep in the WoW UI Discord (Sep 15, 2026) that Midnight's disarmament, incl. secrets, is active; nothing has been publicly tested at 60 on a Forever build.

not_in_addon.why: Needs the combat log, which addons cannot read.

Spy has no Forever version and relied on the combat log.
Explicit Blizzard target of the restrictions; enemy identity/casts are Secret.

Classic rank APIs; not mentioned for Forever on any archived page.
wowforevertierlist (from the 1.60.1 interface diff) says ruleset detection exists so an addon can tell Hardcore/PvP/Roleplay apart; the function name is not given.

Built-in; off by default, enable in Options > Gameplay Enhancement (Blizzard dev notes); /cdm picks spells (foreverbase, hearthproof). Supports all classes, racials and trinkets (Oct 8 notes); all ranks = one entry (Oct 15); shows CC duration with DR (Nov 6 hotfix); Seals shown correctly since Nov 9 hotfix. Gaps: no Healthstone, pet cooldowns, weapon enhancements; consumables later.

Built-in swing timer: C_SwingTimer namespace, PLAYER_SWING event and a visibility setting that defaults to off (from client data). Nov 4 notes: Swing Timer bar no longer fades by distance until the swing finishes.

Runtime tests for Secret values/objects (Midnight documentation Forever inherits). Comparing possibly-Secret values of different types returns false instead of erroring; 'if x then' still works as a nil test.
The player's own casts and those of units the player controls stay readable in combat; other units' casts are Secret.
Readable for player units; UnitHealthPercent/UnitHealthMissing/UnitPowerPercent/UnitPowerMissing return Secrets.
Build 70170 added WOW_PROJECT_CAMELOT = 18; select(4, GetBuildInfo()) > 16000 and < 20000 identifies Forever. hearthproof says the client reports WOW_PROJECT_ID 1 (see conflicts).
Blizzard ships settings that force instance chat lockdown (not persisting across restart) and Secret auras/cooldowns/unit identity/spellcasts, for testing out of instances. Setting names not given.

conflicts.detail: Blizzard deep dive (and endgametools/foreverguide/foreverbattlegrounds): 20 min (was 1 h). thetirisfalen: '1-hour cooldown in the current client'. Using 20 min.

Icy Veins Ret leveling: you keep attacking but deal 50% less damage; foreverbattlegrounds: damage dealt halved. thetirisfalen: 'Divine Shield has no damage-dealt penalty' in the current client. Using -50%; verify in game.
51-60 (Icy Veins via loreforever; foreverdb from the launch client) vs 20-60 in 'the database behind one tracker' (loreforever). Using 51-60.

Blizzpro headline says two new battlegrounds but describes only Darkspear Islands (loreforever). foreverdb: client also contains Battle for Gilneas (10v10), Battle for Blackrock (15v15, 50-60) and a five-player Mak'gora Arena, none announced. Recording only the four launch battlegrounds.

Blizzard Nov 2 dev notes: Voice of Truth removed (slot now Oath of Light). foreverbattlegrounds Holy page lists it as a level-20 trainer spell (6 s Silence/Interrupt immunity, 3 min) and uses it in tips; Icy Veins Holy/Prot leveling still mention it. Not imported.
thetirisfalen lists Hammer of the Righteous (spell 407632) in its kit and rotations; no Blizzard or Icy Veins page has it for Forever. Not imported.
Deep dive (Oct 15): usable on allies and enemies (enemy = extra Holy damage + 75% mana refund). Nov 2 notes: friendly targets only, offensive part removed. Using friendly only.
